$comment: Capability DEFAULTS the bridge advertises on /v1/models for known model families. These are configured assumptions, NOT discovered values — neither the Claude Code CLI nor the Codex CLI exposes a machine-readable per-model capability endpoint, so nothing here is ever read from a CLI. Rows are tried in order, first matching regex (case-insensitive) wins: keep specific patterns above generic ones. Figures checked against the provider catalogs 2026-07-21 (Anthropic: Opus 4.x output caps at 32k, Sonnet/Haiku 4.x reach 64k; OpenAI: developers.openai.com/api/docs/models). Context windows are SHARED by prompt + reasoning + output. Models matching no row report caps_source "unknown" with no invented figures. Per-deployment overrides: BRIDGE_MODEL_CAPS.

defaults.note: Opus 4.x API output ceiling is 32k, not 64k
